author.name: Nuzo Onoh
author.biography: Award-winning author of supernatural fiction, pioneering African horror. Nuzo Onoh's work explores folklore, deities, the unseen and what haunts us.
author.reviewQuote: A vital voice in contemporary horror.

featuredRelease.label: Latest release
featuredRelease.title: The Turning of Sally-Mae
featuredRelease.description: A historical African-Wild West horror story of supernatural vengeance and terrifying occultic magic from the winner of the Bram Stoker Award® for Lifetime Achievement. Two fearsome deities battle each other for the souls of white twins destined to either bring vengeful devastation or salvation to their community in Texas, USA, for a great injustice done to their mother.

sally-mae.title: The Turning of Sally-Mae
sally-mae.subtitle: An African horror novel
sally-mae.quote: Nuzo Onoh is a true original
sally-mae.summary:
When Sally-Mae Jenkins is violated and impregnated by the twin scions of a wealthy rancher, she's sent to join the African missionary ship as a widow. Pregnant and terrified, Sally-Mae vows vengeance on all those who abused her and her family.

Amara is a young woman with the body and face of an old hag. The village outcast, Amara can 'eat' the diseases ravaging the villagers and cure the most deadly ailments. But her powers drain her youth and her strength and the only help she has is the fearsome entity that claimed her soul, the spirit known as Aja-Mmọ, the death-giver and physician of the dead.

futility.title: Futility
futility.subtitle: Murder. Revenge. Soup.
futility.excerpt:
she stomped into one of the two bedrooms
in the small flat… and slumped on the bed,
cradling her head in her hands.
“Just take a deep breath, Claire. That’s it.
Slowly, deeply, that’s good. Just calm yourself.
Mustn’t let things get to you.”
futility.summary: In Abuja, two women’s betrayals draw the attention of a spirit offering revenge. Chia’s celebrated restaurant conceals a disturbing secret behind its irresistible pepper soup. When Claire, a British woman consumed by jealousy, spends an evening there, her carefully managed life begins to unravel. Their stories collide in a darkly comic tale of vengeance, deception and exchanged identities.

dead-brides.title: Where the Dead Brides Gather
dead-brides.subtitle: A novel by Nuzo Onoh
dead-brides.summary: Young Bata finds herself protecting her cousin from a murderous ghost on the eve of a wedding. An attempted exorcism sends her into Ibaja-La, a realm inhabited by brides who died before they could marry. Returning with new powers, she must learn to confront its dangerous spirits and protect the people she loves.

unclean.title: The Unclean
unclean.subtitle: A novel by Nuzo Onoh
unclean.summary: After her dead child is left in a feared forest, Desee refuses to accept her loss. Seeking a way to restore his life, she turns to a powerful witch-doctor. Her choices draw her into a dangerous ordeal where love, grief and dark beliefs carry devastating consequences.

sleepless.title: The Sleepless
sleepless.subtitle: A novel by Nuzo Onoh
sleepless.summary: During the Biafran War, young Obele knows a terrible secret about her brother’s death. A mysterious voice and new friends at an abandoned house offer a way through the dangers around her, but their help comes at a cost. As she tries to release her brother’s trapped spirit, Obele faces threats from the living and the dead.
